title: 鳄鱼凭啥活过霸王龙？
title_en: How Did Crocodiles Outlive T. rex?

segments.zh: The asteroid wiped out T. rex.
The crocodile basically just moved.
segments.en: 鳄鱼呢，基本上只是搬了个家。

segments.zh: Sixty six million years ago, a rock ten kilometers wide
segments.en: 六千六百万年前，一块十公里宽的石头

segments.zh: slammed into Mexico.
About three quarters of all species vanished,
segments.en: 大约四分之三的物种消失了，

segments.zh: including every dinosaur that could not fly.
segments.en: 包括所有不会飞的恐龙。

segments.zh: But crocodiles made it.
Their family is still here today.
And their family used to be wild:
armored plant eaters, land hunters, giants over a ton.
segments.en: 披甲的素食者、陆地猎手、一吨多重的巨兽。

segments.zh: One called Sarcosuchus
could grow up to twelve meters long.
Today's brain teaser:
how does a cold blooded reptile outlive T. rex?
segments.en: 一只冷血爬行动物，凭什么活过霸王龙？

segments.zh: A new study led by University College London
segments.en: 伦敦大学学院牵头的一项新研究，

segments.zh: went looking for the answer.
They dug through more than seven thousand fossils and records
segments.en: 他们翻了七千多条化石和记录，

segments.zh: from over four hundred species.
Then they used climate models
to rebuild two hundred forty five million years of weather.
segments.en: 重建了两亿四千五百万年的气候。

segments.zh: Their finding, in one sentence:
crocodiles follow the heat.
Think of a croc as a solar powered robot.
segments.en: 把鳄鱼想成一台太阳能机器人：

segments.zh: No sun, no power.
When Earth got hot,
crocodile relatives spread toward the poles.
segments.en: 鳄鱼的亲戚就往两极扩张。

segments.zh: Fifty million years ago, Earth was about ten degrees warmer.
segments.en: 五千万年前，地球比现在热大约十度，

segments.zh: Crocodile relatives lived in Antarctica.
segments.en: 南极洲都有鳄鱼的亲戚。

segments.zh: When Earth cooled,
they retreated to the tropics.
Twist one: mostly, they did not change to fit the climate.
segments.en: 反转一：它们多半不是改变自己去适应，

segments.zh: They changed address.
Scientists call it climatic niche conservatism.
segments.en: 科学家管这叫气候生态位保守。

segments.zh: I call it never leaving your favorite blanket.
segments.en: 我管这叫：永远不离开最爱的那条毯子。

segments.zh: Now, the asteroid.
Dust and soot blocked the sunlight.
segments.en: 尘埃和烟灰挡住了阳光。

segments.zh: The planet got darker
and colder.
The team ran simulations
with five or ten percent less sunlight.
segments.en: 阳光少百分之五，或者少百分之十。

segments.zh: Near the equator, it stayed warm enough
for crocodiles.
Twist two, the sneaky one:
they were already in the right place.
segments.en: 它们本来就站在对的位置。

segments.zh: As the lead author puts it, the asteroid did not make the whole planet
segments.en: 第一作者说，小行星并没有让整个地球

segments.zh: equally hostile to everyone.
The team's earlier modeling showed
dinosaur habitats shrank far more.
segments.en: 恐龙的栖息地缩得多得多。

segments.zh: Only with fifteen percent less sunlight
segments.en: 只有阳光少到百分之十五，

segments.zh: would the tropical refuge fail.
The researchers think that extreme case
is unlikely.
segments.en: 那种极端情况不太可能。

segments.zh: Crocs had other tricks too:
small bodies, a life half in water, and they eat almost anything.
segments.en: 个头小，半泡在水里，什么都吃。

segments.zh: Being cold blooded helped as well.
Low energy needs, so they can wait out hunger.
In a dark world, a hungry T. rex was in big trouble.
segments.en: 黑暗的世界里，饿肚子的霸王龙麻烦大了。

segments.zh: A croc could wait.
Twist three, and it is about today:
crocodiles handle climate change by moving.
segments.en: 鳄鱼应对气候变化，靠的是搬家。

segments.zh: But now there are roads, farms and cities
in the way.
The team says crocodiles need room
to move.
Their ancestors walked all the way to Antarctica.
segments.en: 它们的祖先能走到南极洲，

segments.zh: Today's crocs can barely cross a highway.
segments.en: 今天的鳄鱼却连一条高速都过不去。

segments.zh: The lesson of two hundred million years:
sometimes survival just means being able to move.
segments.en: 活下来，有时候就是能搬家。

segments.zh: Fine print: this is a model of the deep past,
segments.en: 友情提示：这是对远古的模型，

segments.zh: pieced together from fossils and simulations.
segments.en: 靠化石和模拟拼出来的。

segments.zh: Body size, diet and water
mattered too, not just climate.
segments.en: 也都很重要，不只是气候。

segments.zh: So how did crocodiles outlive T. rex?
segments.en: 所以，鳄鱼凭什么活过霸王龙？

segments.zh: They always had the seat closest to the heater.
segments.en: 它一直坐在离暖气最近的位置。

segments.zh: The asteroid ended the age of dinosaurs.
segments.en: 小行星终结了恐龙时代。

segments.zh: The crocodile just never left the heater.
segments.en: 鳄鱼呢，只是没离开暖气。
